description: Defines the BoundFunction interface for functions bound to input types in Spark SQL connector catalog, including method signatures for input/output data types, nullability, determinism, and canonical naming.

classes.name: BoundFunction
classes.description: Interface representing a function bound to specific input types in Spark SQL, providing methods for input/output data types, nullability, determinism, and naming.

methods.name: inputTypes
methods.description: Returns the required data types of the input values for this function.

methods.name: resultType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the values produced by this function.

methods.name: isResultNullable
methods.description: Indicates whether the function's output may be null.

methods.name: isDeterministic
methods.description: Indicates whether the function's output is deterministic.

methods.name: canonicalName
methods.description: Provides a unique canonical name for the function to determine equivalence.
